        "mysql"
      ]
    },

      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 4096,
      "description": "Legacy clients only; use structured fields for new installations. Must be empty when structured fields are supplied."
    },
    "host": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 253
    },
    "port": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 65535
    },

      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 63
    },
    "username": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 128
    },
    "password": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 1024
    },
    "tls": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "加密连接开关；关闭为本机与内网直连的默认值，开启后加密传输但不校验服务器证书（自签名可用）。"
    },
    "tls_verify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "With tls enabled, verify the server certificate against system trusted CAs and verify the connection hostname. Defaults to false for existing callers."
    }
  }
}

  ],

      "type": "string"
    },
    "username": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Phone number bound at registration; empty when not collected."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Profile nickname echo; empty when the account never set one and displays fall back to the username."
    },
    "role_names": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Catalogue names parallel to the roles array so listings render names without a roles:read grant; deleted rows fall back to the raw id."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Assigned role ids: the administrator realm is fixed to super_admin; user accounts hold the builtin user role and/or custom roles."
      }
    },
    "permissions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "created_at": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "last_login_at": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "totp_enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Read-only authenticator enrollment status; no keys or recovery codes are exposed."
    },
    "department_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 64,
      "description": "Department the user belongs to; empty when unassigned. Administrator accounts never carry one."
    },
    "menu_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "maxItems": 2048,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "action_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "maxItems": 2048,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "operation_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "maxItems": 2048,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "post_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 64
      },

      "uniqueItems": true
    }

UserCreate
{
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "username",
    "email",
    "password"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "username": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 3,
      "maxLength": 64,
      "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{2,63}$"
    },
    "email": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "email",
      "maxLength": 254
    },
    "password": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 12,
      "maxLength": 128
    },
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Optional phone number bound to the account.",
      "maxLength": 21,
      "pattern": "^(?:\\+?[0-9]{5,20})?$"
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 80,
      "description": "Optional profile nickname set at creation time."
    },
    "role": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 64,
      "description": "Optional single-role shorthand. Do not combine with role_ids.",
      "x-go-value": true
    },
    "department_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 64,
      "description": "Shared account department: omit on update to retain it, empty string clears it; a non-empty id must reference an existing department."
    },
    "post_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "maxItems": 2048,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "role_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 64,
      "uniqueItems": true,
      "description": "Complete role assignment. Omit on update to retain existing roles. Role assignment requires roles:write."
    }
  }
}
UserUpdate

    },

      "maxLength": 64,

    },

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "maxItems": 2048,

    },
    "role_ids": {

      "items": {

        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 64
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 64,

    }

错误目录

统一响应包含 code、message、request_id；校验错误可附 fields。日志和错误响应不回显提交值。

ACCOUNT_EXISTS · 409

账号或邮箱已存在

ACCOUNT_FLOW_DISABLED · 409

此实例尚未开放该账号流程

ALREADY_INSTALLED · 409

此实例已安装，不能重复初始化

AUTH_REQUIRED · 401

登录已失效，请重新登录

BODY_TOO_LARGE · 413

请求体过大

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_INVALID · 403

安装凭据无效，请读取部署数据目录中的 bootstrap.token

CAPTCHA_INVALID · 400

验证码不正确或已过期，请刷新后重试

CSRF_INVALID · 403

请求校验已失效，请刷新页面

DATABASE_INITIALIZED · 409

目标数据库已有安装记录，请恢复原实例配置，不能重新安装

DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE · 400

无法连接或初始化数据库，请检查配置与权限后重试

DEPARTMENT_IN_USE · 409

部门下仍有子部门或挂靠用户，请先迁移后再删除

INSTALL_COMMITTED · 500

安装已完成，请前往登录页面

INSTALL_REQUIRED · 409

请先完成安装

INTERNAL_ERROR · 500

操作未完成，请重试

INVALID_INPUT · 400

请检查输入类型、范围及当前形态是否支持

INVALID_JSON · 400

JSON 格式不正确

LAST_SUPER_ADMIN · 409

不能禁用或降权最后一个启用且可用本地密码登录的管理员

LOCAL_PASSWORD_REQUIRED · 409
